column1: # fe-template-route-exclusions.tsv -- primary fe-gateway routes that the per-brand
# template templates/apps/20-gateway-fe.yaml.hbs deliberately does NOT carry.
# Format: <primary route id><TAB><reason>. One route per line; `#` starts a comment.
# Name the route by its id IN THE PRIMARY TABLE (specs/cluster/apps/20-gateway-fe.yaml).
# Every entry is CHECKED, not trusted: the id must exist in the primary table, the
# rendered brand table must NOT carry it (a stale entry goes red), and the reason
# must be non-empty. Add a line only for a route that is genuinely mesh-wide or
# primary-only; "the brand lane does not deploy that service yet" is not a reason,
# because the template already routes to services that have no brand Application
# (login-ui, api-docs, remote-fragment, host-shell) and a request to an absent
# Service fails there rather than being misrouted to another one.
# EMPTY as of 2026-11-04: every route on the primary fe table is per-domain. The
# mesh-wide superadmin surface is NOT on this table at all; it is its own gateway
